mapper.select: select call.sys_id, call.call_cd, coalesce(setting.call_nm, call.call_cd) as call_nm, call.description, call.insert_datetime from consumer_staff_call call left join consumer_staff_call_setting setting on setting.sys_plant_cd = call.sys_plant_cd and setting.call_cd = call.call_cd where call.sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and call.read_yn = 'N' order by call.insert_datetime asc, call.sys_id asc
mapper.update: update consumer_staff_call set read_yn = 'Y' where sys_plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and read_yn = 'N'
